title: 15-Year-Old Schoolboy Loses Hand After Picking Up Police Stun Grenade During French School Protests
detail: A 15-year-old schoolboy lost his hand after picking up a police stun grenade during the ongoing French school protests, significantly escalating concern over police conduct and likely to intensify the protest movement. The incident raises serious questions about the use of crowd-control munitions near minors and is expected to further galvanise student demonstrators across France.
